title: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank Ltd - 542904 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Ujjivan SFB Q4FY26: Q4 PAT annualised to ROA 2.1%, but FY27 guidance of ~1.6% ROA, ~25% advances growth and 1.4-1.5% credit cost.
summary.overview: Q4FY26 showed strong operating momentum: NII rose 26.4% YoY to INR1,092 crores, NIM improved to 8.5%, disbursements hit a record INR9,811 crores, and gross loan book reached INR40,655 crores (+26.6% YoY). Exit-quarter PAT was INR282 crores (ROA 2.1%, ROE 17.2%) versus FY26 PAT of INR693 crores (ROA 1.4%, ROE 10.9%). The RBI returned the bank's application for voluntary transition to a universal bank; management will reapply later with a more diversified portfolio. Management guided to a higher secured mix (about 56% by March 2027), a board-approved equity raise of up to INR2,000 crores in H2FY27, and FY27 ROA of around 1.6%, below the Q4 exit rate.

segments.name: Secured portfolio
segments.commentary: Reached INR20,079 crores (+43.5% YoY, +12.6% QoQ), now 49.4% of gross book. Housing +43.4% YoY and MSME +57.9% YoY; the housing vertical crossed INR10,000 crores.

segments.name: Micro banking
segments.commentary: Portfolio INR20,709 crores (+6.9%); Q4 disbursements a record INR5,245 crores (+11.9% QoQ). FY26 new customer additions 5.4 lakh. Management guides FY27 growth below 10%, a higher single digit.

segments.name: Newer lines (gold, vehicle, agri)
segments.commentary: Grew 292%, 102% and 127% YoY respectively; together about 6% of loan mix versus 3% in FY25. Gold yield is above 14%; micro mortgage yield is 19.7%.

segments.name: Liabilities
segments.commentary: Retail TD plus CASA INR31,955 crores (70% of deposits). CD ratio 89%, LCR 142%.

guidance_outlook: FY27 advances growth around 25%: secured about 40% and unsecured about 10%, per the Chief Credit Officer.
FY27 credit cost moderates to 1.4-1.5% of average GLB (exit quarter DuPont credit cost about 1.1%, per the call).
FY27 ROA around 1.6%, base case, with upside possible; NIM guided at around 8.5%, in line with the Q4 exit level.
Opex to ATA 20-30bps above FY26 in FY27 due to investment, then expected to decline; cost to income to stay at FY26 levels.
Secured share about 56% by March 2027. CASA ratio about 29-30% (Head of Retail Liabilities said around 30%).

Equity raise up to INR2,000 crores, planned for H2FY27. About 20% branch addition in FY27 (about 140 branches on 776 base). Cost of deposits to benefit about 25-30bps from SA rate cuts; no TD repricing planned.
capex_capacity: Branch network 776 as of March 2026; FY27 plan to add about 20% (about 140 branches, confirmed by management as broadly yes).
Digital, AI and analytics investment on a cloud-led data platform; the spend is driving the opex increase.
Equity raise up to INR2,000 crores, to maintain buffer over the Board-mandated 20% CAR threshold and fund growth for about 3 years.
No inorganic acquisition of secured book is planned.
demand_pricing: Industry bank credit grew 16% to INR219 lakh crore and deposits 13.4% to INR268 lakh crore as of March 31, 2026.
Management cut SA rates in April; expects a 25-30bps reduction in SA cost of funds. SA exit cost of funds was 5.21% in March.
No plan to reprice retail or bulk TDs or MFI yields; management is watching competitors who have raised TD rates.
Gold ticket size rose about 60% YoY, with yields up about 30bps QoQ after lowering rates on small tickets.
Management said deposit growth will match credit growth; a slowdown in deposits in the July-August period was deliberate because of excess liquidity.
MFI slippages for Q4 around INR130 crores; Bucket-X collection efficiency 99.8% in March 2026.

qa_highlights.question: Why does ROA fall from about 2% to 1.6% if NIM, opex and credit cost are flat?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said guidance is conservative on opex and credit cost and covers possible stress in a couple of key products; no specific line item was identified. It will update if the number changes materially.

qa_highlights.question: Will the secured mix shift cut yields and margins, and how much cost-of-funds benefit is left?
qa_highlights.answer: About 30bps of deposit repricing benefit remains. Management cites 2-wheeler, gold (above 14%) and micro mortgage (19.7%) yields to offset lower housing and MSME yields. NIM guided at about 8.5%.

qa_highlights.question: Why raise equity when CAR is already strong?
qa_highlights.answer: The asset growth guidance is 25% a year against a Board threshold of 20%, and the bank needs growth capital for about 3 years. The raise is planned for H2FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Why not grow MFI faster, with a larger share of new customers?
qa_highlights.answer: Most FY26 acquired customers are not yet eligible for repeat loans, so growth will be mostly repeat-driven. New-to-bank share is about 25%, possibly rising to 30%, but not 40-45%, which would be too risky.

qa_highlights.question: What is the secured mix target and reapplication timeline for universal bank status?
qa_highlights.answer: The RBI gives no ratio. Management expects about 56% secured by March 2027, and the reapplication timeline will be set after a 2-3 year plan, not immediately.

qa_highlights.question: Is there a contingency provision buffer for ECL or universal bank readiness in FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: No, management has no plan for additional provisions in FY27 beyond the guidance.

risks_watch: ROA guidance of 1.6% sits well below the 2.1% exit rate; management gave no line-item bridge, and the opex investment and mix shift are the main drivers to track.
Secured yield dilution as the mix moves toward housing and MSME; monitor NIM against the 8.5% guide.
Deposit competition: peers have raised TD rates; the bank has no plan to match, so CASA and TD growth need watching.
Micro banking growth held below 10% as repeat-loan-driven; watch the 5.4 lakh new-customer run-rate and any guardrail changes.

West Asia conflict and oil price exposure: management says the book has no FX lending and no oil, gas, defence or aviation exposure, but is tightening 2-wheeler, used vehicle and MSME working capital monitoring.
Equity raise timing (H2FY27) and dilution; universal bank reapplication timeline still undefined.
summary.management_tone: Confident on operating momentum and asset quality, but evasive on the bridge from the 2.1% exit ROA to the 1.6% FY27 guide, deferring to opex and credit cost conservatism. Cautious on the universal bank reapplication, which management said will not happen immediately.
key_quotes: Our financial outcome for Q4 reflects near-normal portfolio and operational performance.
The RBI does not share, direct, or guide a particular ratio.
We are being conservative on both our opex and our credit cost.
So we have broadly constructed our secured and unsecured ratio for this year.

adds.what: About 140 new branches (~20% on 776 base) in FY27

growth.why: FY27 advances growth guided at around 25% (secured ~40%, unsecured ~10% per CCO), backed by a 20% branch addition (~140 on 776), record Q4 disbursements of INR9,811 crore (+32.1% YoY) and a planned up-to-INR2,000 crore equity raise in H2FY27; no quantified order or capacity-utilisation figures given, so backing is partial.
